This maize plot is our main food for the year, so I must put fertilizer even though prices are high. I will try to get some subsidized fertilizer through the AIP program, and I will use hybrid seed from the agrodealer because it yields better than the local seed I saved. I have some manure from my goats that I will spread before planting, and I intercrop with pigeon peas to help the soil. I cannot afford to irrigate — I depend on the rains — and weeding will be done mostly by me, my wife and the older children, but I will hire a few people for the first weeding because the plot is big.
